## DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 Abliterated API

DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 Abliterated is a large language model by DeepSeek, available on the Venice API as `e2ee-deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017-abliterated`. It is end-to-end encrypted.

DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 Abliterated running in a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE). A text-only reasoning and coding model with refusal behavior removed and a 1M-token context window. Hardware attestation evidence is available for independent verification of enclave identity and configuration.

### DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 Abliterated API pricing

### How to use the DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 Abliterated API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "e2ee-deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017-abliterated"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "e2ee-deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017-abliterated",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }]
  }'
```
